voice_description: Native Japanese female voice for the heroine of a dramatic fantasy anime. Regal warmth and a powerful, emotionally committed battle performance. Deliver the spell as escalating action: a focused invocation, gathering force, then an explosive and clearly articulated final attack name. The inner angel and inner devil are the SAME woman, with only a change of attitude: a pointed moral question versus a restrained warning. Preserve one recognizable vocal identity throughout. Natural Japanese acting, not soft narration or uniform shouting. Clean studio recording.
text:
[determined] 二人を守って。
清き水のぬしよ。
水よ、集え。
雲の上に、海をなせ。
炎を鎮め、
罪なき者に、救いを――
[shouts] そうりゅうてんけい！
[calm] ゆっくりでいい。
無事よ。下で待ってる。
[serious] 協定を忘れないで。
[questioning] それで、見殺しにするの？
scope: 本体、咏唱、天使和恶魔共用同一候选声线
